channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tacko Fall | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tacko Fall from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Tacko Fall
item.description:
Nurse on the plan for Tacko Fall:

“Yeah, just look at him right now and see what happens. He'd be in the same category as 5-6 of the other guys. We still have a two-way spot that's open. There's some guys fighting for that, possibly he'd be one of those guys.”

Nick Nurse on Tacko Fall, Sep 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Robert Williams on Tacko Fall
item.description:
Jay King:Robert Williams on Tacko Fall:

“He doesn’t want to be known as a 7-footer that can’t move. You can see the progress he’s making,you can see that he’s grinding and he wants to be known for different stuff. And you can’t do nothing but respect it.”

Robert Williams on Tacko Fall, Jul 20, 2020. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Tacko Fall
item.description:
Danny Ainge on @Toucherandrich on Tacko Fall:

“We’re trying to still get a contract done with Tacko. We haven’t signed him yet. I really can’t say much more about Tacko than we’re just trying to get him in the fold. … Hopefully we can get that done but we’ll see.”

Danny Ainge on Tacko Fall, Jul 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @ChrisForsberg_.
